identified_idle_in_transaction_sources.source: get_db() yielded request-scoped sessions without committing on normal request completion.
identified_idle_in_transaction_sources.risk: Read-only or dependency queries can leave an implicit SQLAlchemy transaction open until final close, showing as idle in transaction under long request finalization paths.

identified_idle_in_transaction_sources.source: Middleware opened direct SessionLocal() contexts for auth, permission, org context, and data isolation checks.
identified_idle_in_transaction_sources.risk: Early returns relied on Session.close() rollback protection rather than an explicit commit/rollback/finally lifecycle.

identified_idle_in_transaction_sources.source: Service-local SessionLocal() context managers existed outside FastAPI dependency finalization.
identified_idle_in_transaction_sources.risk: Background or helper paths could leave read transactions open until context close.

identified_idle_in_transaction_sources.source: PostgreSQL engine options enforced statement_timeout only.
identified_idle_in_transaction_sources.risk: Idle transactions were not killed by PostgreSQL at the connection level.

remediation.request_dependency: get_db() now follows yield, commit, rollback on exception, close in finally.
remediation.direct_sessions: Added managed_session() and moved middleware/service-local SessionLocal contexts onto it.
remediation.terminal_guard: ManagedSession.close() still rolls back any open transaction before releasing the connection.

postgres_activity_query.idle_in_transaction_query: select pid, usename, application_name, state, now() - xact_start as transaction_age, query from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database() and state = 'idle in transaction' and pid <> pg_backend_pid() order by xact_start nulls last
postgres_activity_query.open_transaction_query: select count(*) from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database() and xact_start is not null and pid <> pg_backend_pid()
